schemaMarkup.reviewBody: I visited this dental clinic for the first time today, and was thoroughly impressed with the staff. My dentist, as well as her assistant, was extremely nice and knowledgeable. Today's visit was to determine the treatment that will be needed. I look forward to returning to complete the work to be done soon.

My mom has early-stage dementia, so there’s an internal anxiety associated with doctors' offices. The Riccobene staff was exceptional in comforting my mom throughout her dental procedure. Special thanks to the assistant who provided Mom a blanket, chapstick, and assistance to the restroom. I am her caretaker, but it’s nice to have others who care as well. Thank you all!

My total experience was exceptional. My oral examination was precise, and my discussion with the staff was clear with respect to the areas I needed to pay attention to after my visit. I spoke with people who were familiar with me and who genuinely care for my well-being.

Such a great experience! My hygienist made me feel so comfortable and did a very thorough cleaning of my teeth. The doctor was awesome! He provided me with all the information I needed to understand my dental health! I really love the atmosphere of the office. Everyone was so pleasant and uplifting, and it was refreshing coming from a not-so-great dental office. I really appreciate the staff at Riccobene, and this will certainly be my new dentist location!

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What are your office hours in Rocky Mount, NC?

Our office Hours are Monday-Thursday: 8:30 AM – 4:00 PM and Friday: 8:30 AM – 1:00 PM. We are closed on Saturday and Sunday.

Do you provide teeth whitening services in Rocky Mount, NC?

Yes, we understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include teeth whitening.

What are dental sealants, and do you offer them in Rocky Mount, NC?

Dental sealants are thin, transparent coatings applied to the surface of the back teeth that protect them from bacteria and thereby prevent cavities. At Rocky Mount, we offer dental sealants to keep your oral health at its best!

How long does a typical dental cleaning appointment take?

Usually, a dental cleaning appointment takes around 30 to 60 minutes, depending on your individual needs. A routine cleaning for healthy teeth tends to be quicker, but if more extensive cleaning is needed, the appointment will take longer.
